remarks: An open main level, three upstairs bedrooms and a patio make this Caspian Villas end-unit townhome a welcoming place to settle in. Approximately 1,630 square feet are arranged over two stories, with two upstairs bathrooms and a convenient downstairs powder room. The connected kitchen, dining and living areas create an inviting setting for weeknight meals and relaxed gatherings. Step onto the patio for morning coffee or time outdoors, then enjoy the comfort of central heating and air conditioning.
